execution_gate_delta.meaning: A session-issued per-command execution capability was revoked or stale before a further stage. It is not collaborator malfunction or mathematical no-path.
execution_gate_delta.cleanup: N2 scope.finish remains exactly once whenever admitted, including cancellation. Its cleanup lane can finalize/release resources and retain actual late result/completion in separate correlated audit. After owner terminal sealing, no new ordinary grants or frozen main-chain members are allowed; already granted in-flight storage outcomes remain actual late/unknown-storage evidence, not false NONE. Collector never calls lifecycle lock or session callback while holding its IO lock.
execution_gate_delta.collector_locking: Session terminal/denial/freeze/final retention ports do not wait for collector IO: nonblocking acquisition and no reentrant external callback IO. Busy returns truthful NOT_CONFIRMED, preserving pending evidence. Collector-owned code invokes no lifecycle execution callback; injected clock/store callbacks may reenter owner while collector RLock is held, supported by terminal nonblocking acquisition and IO-depth refusal. Session-owned N2 checks gate after clock/store callbacks; late physical storage stays correlated audit and never frozen main-chain membership. Collector capture_disposition is distinct from stage_grant and acquires only an independent nonblocking token lock, never lifecycle lock.
execution_gate_delta.finalization_identity: Lifecycle and denial finish are exactly once. Reservation remains held through actual final-result sidecar observation or explicit expiry; once-final sidecar uses separate immutable reference, never overwrites tentative supporting node. Own retention receipt remains API-only to prevent acknowledgment recursion.
execution_gate_delta.collector_binding: With execution_gate None RecoveryEngine calls existing recovery_capture()/assessment_capture(relation=...) without new kwargs, preserving arbitrary legacy collaborators. Session-gated calls pass execution_gate to exact ReferenceDiagnostics additive keyword ports; scope stores trusted gate, and complete_assessment/_complete uses that scope-bound gate for post-IO/late cleanup checks.

live_origin.association: Owner stores exact complete assessment and accepted generation. A current pointer is valid only with actual current state, current context, complete same collector prefix and exact full source/profile bindings. State-cycle equality alone cannot restore membership.
live_origin.admission: Submitted full expected_snapshot must equal actual public snapshot before lease issuance. Private owner creates distinct active snapshot at the same state/mode generation; the exact lease retains before and active_snapshot. Commit checks actual active snapshot against owner-issued active snapshot, not caller before.
live_origin.post_commit: State/mode publication increments generation; current assessment reference/class are null and admission AUDIT_BLOCKED until actual current-context assessment and completion are confirmed. Confirmed N2 postassessment can be associated to recovered publication; containment/resolution perform actual two-event post-mode child pair. Owner-held post-mode active snapshot becomes the gate phase baseline; immutable lease keeps initial active snapshot. Halt leaves both assessment fields null.
live_origin.context_unavailable: No actual assessment class is invented. Mode is independently authoritative terminal/containment state.

raw_business_guard.mandatory_halt: Latch first even on overflow. Do not label oversize value a valid raw packet. Return PendingLifecycleRecord reason RAW_BUSINESS_LIMIT and actual terminal snapshot; preserve complete immutable API object DAG and PARTIAL persisted coverage. No silently shortened full_diagnostic_chain.
raw_business_guard.bounded_return: SessionRawBusinessFailure is the bounded execute return for ordinary wire-limit refusal or mandatory terminal overflow. Complete immutable actual result/history remain API object-DAG; do not embed oversize N2 packet in the compact descriptor or claim a valid raw serialization.
